# Career pipeline runtime fixtures

These fictional inputs test full accounting, not real opportunities or applicants.
Each track contains 16 distinct URLs and 17 source observations across three sources.
The native assistant must read the evidence, author all assessments, and use the
shared pipeline to calculate scores and render every result. No scores or completed
assessments are supplied. Industry, graduate admissions, and postdoc searches cover
unknown eligibility, unknown dimensions, a weak fit, a closed listing, a confirmed
credential failure, unavailable evidence, a duplicate alias, and an explicit
non-US location exclusion. The runtime verifier independently checks saved data and
all report rows; exact subjective fit values need not match between assistants.
